blocks.text: Processor: 13th Gen Intel N100 Processor (4 cores, up to 3.4GHz turbo speed, 6MB cache, 4 threads) Memory: Up to 32GB DDR5 SO-DIMM RAM Storage: Up to 640GB Total Storage (128GB UFS Internal + 512GB External Flash Drive) Graphics: Integrated Intel UHD Graphics Optical Drive: None Form Factor: All-in-One Display: 21.5" Full HD (1920x1080) IPS Display, Anti-glare, 16:9 aspect ratio, 60Hz refresh rate, low blue light, flicker-free Audio: High-Definition stereo speakers with enhanced clarity Camera: HD webcam with privacy shutter and built-in dual microphone for clear video calls Keyboard & Mouse: Traditional Wired USB Keyboard & Mouse Ports & Connectivity: 1x USB Type-C (5Gbps, data transfer only) 2x USB Type-A (Hi-Speed) 1x USB Type-A (5Gbps) 1x 3.5mm headphone/microphone combo jack 1x RJ-45 Ethernet port 1x HDMI-out WiFi 6 & Bluetooth 5.3 for high-speed wireless connectivity Power Supply: 65-Watt AC adapter Dimensions (H x W x D): Approx. 15.8 x 19.3 x 6.5 inches Weight: Around 10.5 lbs

items: 【Processor】 Latest 13th Gen Intel N100 Processor (4 cores, up to 3.4GHz, 6MB cache, 4 threads) with integrated Intel UHD Graphics, delivering efficient performance for everyday computing.

【High-Speed Memory & Storage】Equipped with 16 GB DDR5 RAM, 512GB External and 128GB UFS , this system minimizes delays and loading times-ensuring lightning-fast data access, quick boot-ups, and seamless multitasking.

【Ports】 1x USB Type-C (5Gbps, data transfer only), 2x USB Type-A (Hi-Speed), 1x USB Type-A (5Gbps), 1x headphone/microphone combo (3.5mm), 1x RJ-45 Ethernet, 1x HDMI-out, and built-in WiFi 6 & Bluetooth 5.3 for seamless connectivity.

【Display and Built-in Features】 21.5" Full HD (1920 x 1080) display, offering sharp visuals with an anti-glare coating for comfortable viewing. Dual stereo speakers provide clear and immersive audio, while a built-in HD webcam with a privacy shutter ensures secure video conferencing and online meetings.
【Professional Software Bundle】Comes with Windows 11 and Microsoft Office 365 web offering enhanced productivity tools and advanced security features-perfect for business users and professionals.
